svg.text: Cut the profile from 40 mm plate (waterjet), then mill both faces to 36 mm.

svg.text: Jaw: 250 mm from the pivot to the tip; straight inner face; outer edge

svg.text: 70 deep near the pivot, curving to 16 deep at the tip.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tail: pin bore 25.4 mm, 160 mm from the pivot, 140 deg round

svg.text: from the jaw's inner face, behind the pivot.

svg.text: A centre knuckle 18 mm thick: face 9 mm off each side within a 61 mm radius of the pivot.

svg.text: Pockets 8 deep both faces, 12 in from the edges, in the jaw and tail.
